sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Hotel-stay factors are intended for Scope 3 emissions from overnight business-travel hotel stays.
The factors are published in the Hotel Stay worksheet of the full conversion-factor set.
Hotel-stay factors remain constant from the 2022 conversion-factor publication.
The 2026 hotel factors are not all aligned to AR5 because source data were reported in CO2e without gas-level breakdowns.
All published hotel-stay factors are expressed on a CO2e basis.
The factors come from the Cornell Hotel Sustainability Benchmarking Index tool using annual data from international hotel organisations.
Country median benchmarks across included hotel classes were used for the underlying factor set.
The source process harmonised units and applied validity tests to remove outliers or errors.
The source grouped data by geography, climate zone and hotel property segment and required a minimum number of hotels for outputs.
The methodology warns that the source sample is skewed toward larger/upmarket branded hotels and is not fully verified.
